description_en: Creates a data backup for an ApsaraDB for Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instance
description_zh: 为云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例创建数据备份
name: CreateBackup

parameters.help_en: The retention period of this manual backup. Valid values: 7 to 730. Unit: days. If you set this parameter to -1, the manual backup does not expire within the instance lifetime. If you do not specify this parameter, the retention period is the same as that of the current automatic backup policy
parameters.help_zh: 本次手动备份的过期时长，取值范围为7~730天。当您传入-1时，表示本次手动备份数据不过期（实例生命周期内）；当您不传入任何值（默认情况），表示与当前自动备份策略一致
parameters.name: backup_retention_period

BackupJobID.description_en: The backup task ID. For cluster instances created before December 5, 2023, the return value consists of the job IDs of individual child DB nodes. For example, for a cluster instance with two shards, the BackupJobID value is returned in the format of "10000,10001". For cluster instances created on or after December 5, 2023, all DB nodes in a cluster are described by a single job ID. You only need to use this single job ID
BackupJobID.description_zh:
备份任务ID。  
针对2023-12-05前申请的集群实例，返回值是由各个子DB节点的jobId组成，例如2分片的集群实例，BackupJobID值的返回值会如 "10000,10001"。  
针对2023-12-05之后申请的集群实例，一个集群下所有DB节点的job统一由一个jobId描述，用户只需关心这一个jobId即可
